chunks: Regarding what the sky (rain) and the rivers irrigate, or if it was rain-fed (without human effort), is the one-tenth (10%); and as for what the water-wheels and the buckets irrigate, then it is half of the one-tenth (5%).

So I said to him: 'But the land which happens to be with us — we irrigate it by the buckets, then the water increases and so the rivers irrigate it.' So he said: 'And does this indeed happen with you like that?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'The half and the half — half with half of the one-tenth, and half with the one-tenth.'

So I said: 'The land is irrigated by the buckets, then the water increases and it gets irrigated by one irrigation and two irrigations by canal.' He said: 'And in how much is the one irrigation and the two irrigations by canal?' I said: 'In thirty or forty nights, while before that six or seven months had passed in the land (under bucket irrigation).' He said: 'Half of the one-tenth.'

key_terms.الدَّوَالِي: Buckets or pulleys used to draw water from wells for irrigation
key_terms.السَّوَانِي: Water-wheels (saqiya) used to raise water for irrigation
key_terms.الْعُشْرُ: One-tenth (10%), the higher zakat rate on rain-fed agricultural produce
key_terms.بَعْل: Land that absorbs water from the water table or rain without artificial irrigation
key_terms.سَيْح: Water flowing naturally by gravity (rivers, canals)
key_terms.نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ: Half of the one-tenth (5%), the lower zakat rate on mechanically irrigated produce

ai.seo_question: What is the zakat rate on crops irrigated by rain versus buckets in Shia jurisprudence according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal discussion between Muawiya ibn Shurayh and Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the zakat rate on agricultural produce based on irrigation method. The general rule is: 10% for rain-irrigated or river-irrigated land, and 5% for land irrigated by mechanical means such as water-wheels or buckets. The hadith then addresses a complex case — land that is irrigated part of the season by buckets and part by natural water flow — and the Imam provides a proportional ruling: if the proportions are equal, the rate averages to 7.5%. For land primarily bucket-irrigated for most of the season (six or seven months) but receiving only one or two short canal irrigations (30-40 nights), the lower rate of 5% applies.
word_analysis: and the buckets (pulleys for drawing water)

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Shurayh, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘With regards to whatever is irrigated by the sky and the rivers, or if it was un-watered, is the one-tenth (10%), and as for what the scooping and the buckets irrigate, so it is half of the one-tenth (5%)’.

So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘But the land which happens to be with us, we irrigate by the buckets, then the water increases, so the rivers irrigate it’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And is that what is happening with you, like that?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The half and the half. Half being with half of the one-tenth, and half being with the one-tenth’.

So I said, ‘The land irrigated by the buckets, then the water increases, so it gets irrigated by the irrigation, and the two irrigations by the canal’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And in how much is the irrigation, of the one irrigation and the two irrigations of the canal?’ I said, ‘In thirty nights, or forty nights, and it has passed before that in the land, six months, seven months’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Half of the one-tenth’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn Shurayh who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Zakat is one out of ten on what is watered from canals or rain from the sky and it is one out of twenty on what is watered by means of scoops and buckets.

I then said that we have a certain piece of land, which is watered, by means of buckets, then water increases and it then is watered from canals. He (the Imam) asked, ‘Is it how it is with you?’ I replied, ‘Yes, that is how it is.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It then is half and half. Zakat on one half is one out of ten and on the other half it is one out of twenty.’

I then said, ‘There is a piece of land which is watered by means of buckets and then water increases, it then is watered once or twice from canals.’ He (the Imam) asked, ‘Within what time once or twice watering takes place?’ I replied, ‘It happens within thirty or forty nights and before it a period of six or seven months has passed. He (the Imam) said, ‘It (Zakat) is one out of twenty.’”
